en.title: Version 1.3.1
en.content:
**Production container build**
- Install unzip in the build stage so Composer can extract dependency archives without PHP's ZIP extension; keep the extraction tool out of the production stage.
- Add a CI job that builds the actual production image and validates its embedded Caddy configuration.
- Test and document retrying preparation after a failed build, preserving existing files and keeping migrations, scheduled tasks and release publication suspended.
